title.zh-CN: 乏力后逐渐气短、不能平卧 · 57岁女性

summary.zh-CN: 围绕乏力后逐渐气短、不能平卧，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for progressive breathlessness and orthopnoea after fatigue.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合培养与超声识别无热心内膜炎。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别重度返流与心衰的手术紧迫性。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 将过敏史纳入抗菌评估。

text.zh-CN: 3 次均为同一细菌，VITEK2 鉴定为苛养颗粒链球菌，可见卫星现象。
text.en: Three cultures grew the same organism, identified by VITEK2 as Granulicatella adiacens, with satellitism.

text.zh-CN: 主动脉瓣赘生物最大约 25 mm，瓣脱垂及重度返流，LVEF 48%，左心增大。
text.en: Aortic vegetations up to about 25 mm, prolapse and severe regurgitation, LVEF 48% and left-heart enlargement.

text.zh-CN: 原报告称万古霉素等敏感，红霉素、克林霉素耐药；未列 MIC。
text.en: Vancomycin and some other agents were reported susceptible; erythromycin/clindamycin resistant; MICs are absent.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 就诊前已提示可能主动脉瓣赘生物及中度返流，之后加重。
text.en: Possible aortic vegetation and moderate regurgitation had already been reported before subsequent deterioration.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 使用万古霉素等后培养转阴并短期改善；转院后抗菌治疗中断，随后突发进行性气短并死亡。可能瓣膜破坏、栓塞或急性左心衰，具体机制未证实。
text.en: Cultures cleared and symptoms initially improved with vancomycin-based care. Antibiotics were interrupted after transfer; abrupt progressive dyspnoea and death followed. Valve destruction, embolism or acute left-heart failure were considered but not confirmed.

text.zh-CN: 培养与赘生物支持感染性心内膜炎，即使起初无发热

feedback.zh-CN: 直接微生物与结构证据更重要。
feedback.en: Direct microbiological and structural evidence is decisive.

text.zh-CN: 必须先发热才可诊断
text.en: Fever is mandatory before diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告展示了无热起病。
feedback.en: This case demonstrates an afebrile presentation.

text.zh-CN: 腰痛足以确诊单纯脊柱关节炎
text.en: Back pain establishes isolated spondyloarthritis

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释反复阳性培养及瓣毁损。
feedback.en: It cannot explain repeated positive cultures and valve destruction.

prompt.zh-CN: 重度返流及心衰需要怎样处理？
prompt.en: What is needed for severe regurgitation and heart failure?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 感染心内膜炎团队尽快评估外科及针对性抗菌治疗
text.en: An endocarditis team urgently assesses surgery and targeted antibiotics

feedback.zh-CN: 心衰和瓣毁损不能只等待感染完全控制。
feedback.en: Heart failure and valve destruction should not simply await complete infection clearance.

text.zh-CN: 等所有培养长期阴性才联系外科
text.en: Wait for prolonged culture negativity before surgical referral

feedback.zh-CN: 可能错过紧急处理时机。
feedback.en: This may miss the urgent intervention window.

text.zh-CN: 按过敏不详直接继续青霉素
text.en: Continue penicillin without evaluating the documented allergy

feedback.zh-CN: 明确过敏必须纳入药物选择。
feedback.en: The recorded allergy must inform drug selection.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 苛养颗粒链球菌心内膜炎合并严重主动脉瓣损伤，短期感染改善未解除结构风险。
conclusion.en: Granulicatella endocarditis with severe aortic valve injury; temporary infection improvement did not remove structural risk.

keyReasoning.en: Absence of fever does not exclude endocarditis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 未证实的终末机制保留为可能。
